name: Tankard of Sobriety

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Drink from it and you never get drunk.
text: A stern face is carved into one side of this tankard. Wine, ale or any other nonmagical alcohol you take from it never makes you drunk, though it does nothing to magic liquids or to harmful substances like poison. (Purely flavour; it does nothing else in the game.)
